reviews.text:
We are humans and we do mistakes, but you lack of interest in the follow up appointment is giving you one start.

Don't play with people’s time, to take 3 cats to the vet is not easy. Getting extra help involves to take a day off from work.

I work in the medical field and I was taught that patients are always first. A call to reschedule is no taking you more than five minutes.

Too much stress for my cats and for me too.

IF YOU GO TO THIS OFFICE YOU SHOULD CALL with time  AHEAD TO CONFIRM.

Ashley, We are very sorry to see your experience with Oz was 1 star. We were unable to locate an existing file or visit related to this review, and would love the opportunity to connect and learn how we can better support our community, especially with financial support and fair pricing. As a locally and family owned practice we hold ourselves to a very high standard when it comes to supporting our community. I would love the opportunity to connect and learn more about your experience and how we can do better in the future. Please feel free to reach out at your convenience: kyles@ozanimalhospital.com.
We hope to hear from you soon!
Robert, Your 5 stars are greatly appreciated! Thank you for choosing Oz Animal Hospital and allowing us to be part of your pet’s healthcare team.
KT, From our entire Oz team, thank you for the 5-star rating! We appreciate your trust and look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon.

Friendly staff here and reasonable prices. My dog is reactive and they got a room ready for us in advance which we love. The vet and vet tech were kind and thorough. They talked me through next steps for my pups skin condition and gave me some meds. Close to home and can schedule appointments online so we’ve found our new vet!
Kim, Thank you for the 5 stars! We love what we do, and support from our wonderful clients means the world to our team.

I did not have a problem with OZ until about a year ago up until recently. They definitely have some strengths and can be kind and pleasant. While there are caring people who work there they are extremely disorganized. My cat needs gabapentin before any appointment or else an exam just wont happen due to his aggressive behavior. Last year, the vet was super nice but quite young... it seemed like my cat was the worst cat she has ever encountered. Don't get me wrong, he has severe behavior but I expected a vet to know what to do and I sensed a lot of inexperience. It seems like even the techs knew better than the vet. Fast forward to this year, I request gabapentin 10 days before our appointment. I have been told this is a MUST for my cat by all vets due to his behavior and anxiety. I am told I will receive it 3-5 days. After 7 days, I ask again. I specifically say I will need to cancel if I don't have it the morning before our appointment. They promise to call me back. They don't. So I cancel. They seem really disorganized, too busy to follow up, and some of the vets are quite inexperienced. Unfortunately I have to go to a new vet as I cannot chase people down for my cat's much needed medication.

We’ve had a great experience with oz! They are thorough, attentive, and so sweet to our pups! They always check in to make sure our dogs are doing ok after any issues. It’s also so nice to have them so close by in rogers park.

The medical teams are lovely, I’ve had no issues with any vets in charge of my cat’s care. However, I find the few times I have called for scripts, with questions, etc. I am always offered a call back from a medical member and those calls have never come. When I reach out a day later, the admin team has seemed unaware that I am waiting for help. Also, I recently picked up a script that was improperly packaged and most of the contents of the bottle spilled out into the bag. I’m finding myself frustrated with Oz for these issues at the level of reputation they have in Chicago!
Thank you so much for the 5 stars, Edward! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you trust the Oz Animal Hospital team with your pet’s care.

Avoid OZ Animal Hospital – Money-hungry and zero compassion
If you don't want to be charged twice as much as you should be, stay away from this place. OZ Animal Hospital in Rogers Park has terrible staff and veterinarians who only care about money and how they can overcharge you.
They have been seeing my cat for the past 3 years. They have all of his documents, medical history, and prescription receipts scanned into their system from every vet he visited before. His records clearly state that he has an eye herpes condition that flares up once or twice a year, and that he has been prescribed Terramycin ointment for it for the last 5 years.
He recently had a flare-up after I finally ran out of the ointment. Even though I was just there last week for a check-up where we explicitly discussed his herpes condition and how it occurs at most twice a year, they denied the prescription refill. Instead of helping a long-term patient, they demanded I schedule and pay for another appointment just to get the refill, leaving my cat to suffer unnecessarily in the meantime.
The staff is far too lazy to actually check the documentation that they have scanned into their system, and the vets just want to suck you dry financially. Save your money and take your pets somewhere where the staff actually cares about the animals instead of squeezing every last dollar out of you.
Karen, Your 5-star review made our day—thank you! We love caring for our neighborhood pets and are grateful to be part of your pet's healthcare journey.

Received incredible care for my Sweetboi in his final weeks at this office. No one wants to write a review about their pet's final moments, but I know there are people looking for the perfect place. I cannot recommend the lovely people at Oz Animal Hospital in Rogers Park enough. They were very understanding with weighing medical necessity vs mercy, and also helpful with finding the most reasonable and cost-effective pathways for his care. Sweetboi's final moments were comfortable, calm and peaceful. The doctor went through all the steps of what to expect. We had plenty of time and I felt like they gave me a lot of agency and control over the process. My other kitty, Emma, will now be a lifelong patient at this office.
Oz always took really good care of my cat, Mr Spock.
The people here are really nice and explain everything in detail. They genuinely care about your experience.....

We had a just rescued a new cat who was extremely scared of us and we had to reschedule twice because we couldn't get her into the carrier. Finally, we had to have an appointment because she ran out of her anxiety medication. I tried to get her into the carrier and she bit me through the cat gloves I was wearing.
I went over to Oz Animal Hospital, crying, that I couldn't get her into the carrier and thinking we were doing horrible with our new cat and the manager, Marissa, and the man at the front desk calmed me down so much and then literally came over to my apartment and helped me get her into the carrier so she could have her first checkup and get her medicine. They also advised me to go to urgent care for the cat bite.
It was such a rough day but she did so well when she was there and it was such a cat-friendly place and they were so good about keeping her calm and telling me how to reduce her anxiety and reassuring me. I cannot thank them enough, this is the best vet I have ever been to and everyone there is so friendly. I would never go anywhere else. Thank you!
Kelly, Thank you so much for the 5-star rating!  We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you chose us to care for your pet.
Yasmin, Your 5-star review made our day—thank you! We love caring for our neighborhood pets and are grateful to be part of your pet's healthcare journey.
Overall good experience. Relatively easy to find appointment. Friendly staffs.

Oz has been taking good care of our boys since they opened. Today we had to rush one of our dogs in because he got hurt and needed staples in his side. They were able to patch him up and send him home in a little over an hour. Thank you oz!

Responsive, straight-forward and attentative care. I have been bringing my senior dog here for 3 years and am grateful to have this place so close to home. Would recommend to anyone looking for a reliable vet in the area.
Great staff. Very friendly. Good with our cat. Not pushy for extra treatments.
Kind and responsive.
Friendly staff!
They do a great job, but they're re on the expensive side. If you compare the prices online you'll find they charge very close to the maximum for each service.

Making the difficult decision to euthanize a pet is by far one of the hardest things we recently had to face. The compassionate group of pet care givers here, especially Dr. Pinhasi, is fantastic. We have been in Rogers Park for a year now, and without a regular vet in our network, on the morning we needed clarity and peace of mind both, Oz was there for us, last minute at that. Before the procedure, Dr Pinhasi provided several options about how we could proceed. Euthanasia was also discussed. I felt at ease knowing we were all working together to find the most compassionate option for our boy Jack. The entire process of the procedure was explained to us, and every question was answered, along with explaining what our boy would experience during the injection.  We were asked if we would like to be present during the procedure. We were also given the option to stay for as much as we chose to, or to not stay at all if that was easier for us. We felt we owed it to our boy to stay with him through it all. I'm glad we did. The team here is great, the office is soothing and bright, and the cost for an unexpected visit like this was less than we imagined for urgent care, including cremation, complimentary nose and paw prints, and an urn for his ashes. Highly recommended. And thank you once again!

Whether or not this clinic is owned by private equity, they sure act like it.

The vets and vet techs were unprepared at every appointment and never followed up the way they were supposed to. I waited weeks to get a prescription for hypoallergenic food that I was told that I would receive the same or next day every time I followed up.

When I took my cat in for dental surgery, she was returned to me with her butt absolutely covered in feces. It did not seem like they had even attempted to clean her up despite having her all day. I imagine she was just left to sit unmonitored in her feces all day.

At every appointment, vet techs and vets alike consistently had to be reminded of her name and history. We were having issues diagnosing an issue and I consistently had to remind them that we had tried certain interventions when they were suggested a second time. I do not believe the vet was trying to solve the problem my cat was suffering from -- just trying to increase revenue by repeating failed treatments.

The issue was quickly resolved after one visit to another vet when I got sick of throwing good money after bad with these charlatans.

The only reliable communication you can expect is e-mail sales and reminders to spend more and more money.

This clinic does not care about your pets nearly as much as they care about your money.

EDIT: After removing myself from all contact lists for this vet and submitting this review, I began to receive automated updates from the Sauganash location and will have to remove myself from all contact lists a second time. This is simply the bad experience that will not end. I highly recommend staying away from this establishment.

Taken my cats here a few times over the past 3-years. They settle in really great once they get past that initial nervousness; I think that says a lot about the place!

They accept CareCredit which goes a long way. And even have knowledge on some niche topics like preparing your pet for travel! It’s been really great working with them and I love taking my cats here, they come back home completely relaxed and comfortable.

Everyone was so wonderful with my anxious Aussie for his dental/mass removal.  I appreciate their care and expertise so much!  The communication before, during, and after was wonderful!  Thank you Dr.Pinhasi, Jen, Alyssa, Sarah,  Eileen, Alissa, Sam!

I have been taking  my dog to Oz Animal Hospital in Rogers Park last two years. Dr Maoine is kind and loving veterinarian cares for her patients greatly. I travel overseas often.They are helpful with travel papers if needed. I would trust my pets in their care any time.
